summary: Simon Property Group L.P. filed an 8-K to disclose that its indirect subsidiary, Simon Global Development B.V., priced an offering of €500 million aggregate principal amount of 3.650% guaranteed notes due 2031. The offering is made outside the U.S. under Regulation S; the notes are unsecured and fully guaranteed by the parent. Closing is scheduled for June 15, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
